notes.title: Update Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42984114/66784ac0234fc21efdfceaf7787eb5ab59c94f19.gif


Thanks everyone for playing our game! We've listened to your feedback, and added some adjustments to improve the streaming / recording experience as well as quashing some minor bugs.

 See notes below. 


Version 1.1.1 Patch Notes:

 Added ultra-wide screen support.
 Added Windowed Mode (in Settings).
 Added credits screen.
 Added button to reset progress under Options Menu.


More soon.

// Simply,

The Frosty Pop Team
